title: Build the Eneo module kit
description:
Build the starter for Eneo modules: a FastAPI BFF package with the module contract, a React + Astryx UI package, and
a template app that new modules copy.

## Read first
- `README.md`, `docs/design.md`, `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-kit-plan.md`.

## Scope
This repository only. Code is copied from `eneo-ai/eneo-mod-speech-to-text` at commit `f81a7dd`; that repository is
never changed from here.

## Order
Phase 0 → Phase 1 (BFF) and Phase 2 (UI, first part) → Phase 3 (template) → Phase 4 (session client, after
speech-to-text's Phase 1) → Phase 5 (integration and release). `br ready --json` gives the next bead.

## Success Criteria
- A module copied from `template/` signs in through Eneo's handoff, calls Eneo through the deny-by-default proxy and
  runs as one container on port 3001.
- Both packages are released as 0.1.0 and install into a clean consumer.
- No speech-to-text feature, route or copy is in the packages.

title: Phase 1.9: a module's own routes are not shadowed by the proxy or the page fallback
description:
Found by the Phase 1 implementer (kit-bff) and reproduced: a route a module adds after `create_app(...)` is shadowed.
- Under `/api/eneo/`, the proxy catch-all swallows it (`POST /api/eneo/things/1/files` answers 403 "Eneo resource is not exposed").
- With `static_dir` set, the SPA fallback `GET /{path:path}` swallows a module's GET route (`GET /api/mine` answers 404), while a POST at the same path works.
- `/api` itself (no trailing slash) is served as the SPA page; the fallback only checks `startswith("api/")`.
`deps.py` already says a module declares its routes on a router before an app exists, but `create_app` has no way to take one, and `app.include_router(...)` afterwards has the ordering problem above. The template (Phase 3) and speech-to-text's own upload and audio routes (under `/api/eneo/...`) will hit this.

## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-kit-plan.md`: Global Constraints, "How to work", Phase 1 Tasks 1.4, 1.5, 1.7.
- `docs/design.md`: K6, K7, K8, section 5.
- `AGENTS.md`.

## Scope
Branch `feat/bff` (continue it; one more commit). Files: `packages/bff/src/eneo_module_bff/app.py`, `web.py`, `packages/bff/tests/test_app.py`, `test_proxy.py`, `test_web.py`, `packages/bff/README.md`, `docs/design.md` (K7 and section 5), `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-kit-plan.md` (the Task 1.4 interface block and the Phase 3 template row: say `routers=`).

The change, and only this:
1. `create_app(..., routers: Sequence[APIRouter] = ())`. Order of registration: auth router, health, branding, **the module's routers**, then the proxy router, then the static app last. A module's routes therefore win over the proxy catch-all and the SPA fallback; the module still declares its own `Depends(require_session)` and `Depends(require_same_origin)`.
2. The SPA fallback treats `api` and `api/...` as API: 404 JSON, never HTML.
3. A module router must not be able to turn the kit's own routes off: its routes are registered after them, so a duplicate of an kit route (`/api/auth/status`, `/health`, ...) does not replace it. Add a test that proves the kit's route still answers.

## Out of scope
- Any second mechanism (a 404-handler fallback, a plugin system, route priorities). One parameter, one order.
- Changing the proxy rules, `forward_upload`, `stream_signed`, the session code.
- Anything outside the files above.

## Steps
1. Write failing tests first (in the files above): a module router with `POST /api/eneo/things/{id}/files` and with `GET /api/mine` both answer (also with `static_dir` set); an unknown `/api/nope` and `/api` are 404 JSON; the kit's own `/api/auth/status` and `/health` are not replaced by a module router that declares them; the proxy still denies by default.
2. Run: they fail for the reasons above.
3. Implement the three points. Run the whole suite.
4. Update the docs listed in Scope. Commit: `feat(bff): a module's own routes go through create_app and win over the proxy and the page fallback`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The whole suite passes (112 existing + the new tests).
- `GET /api/mine` and `POST /api/eneo/things/1/files` declared on a module router answer, with and without `static_dir`.
- `/api` and `/api/anything-unknown` are 404 with a JSON body.
- The two exit greps (`access_code|AUTH_MODE|DEMO_SPACE|flows/`, and import-time state) still print nothing.

## Verify
```bash
.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s packages/bff/tests -t packages/bff
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead. Do not work around the ordering.

## Steps to Reproduce
On `feat/bff` at 574cbca: `app = create_app(settings, static_dir=dist)`; `app.add_api_route("/api/mine", handler, methods=["GET"])` → `GET /api/mine` is 404 `{"detail":"Not Found"}`; `GET /api` returns the page.

Tests first: 5 added (test_app 2: module routers answer, a router cannot replace /health, /api/healthz, /api/auth/status, /api/auth/callback, /api/branding; test_proxy 1: module POST /api/eneo/things/{id}/files wins with proxy_rules=() while other /api/eneo/ paths stay 403 with no upstream call and the module's own session/origin deps hold; test_web 2: /api, /api/, /api/nope, /api/anything/unknown are 404 JSON; module GET /api/mine and POST /api/eneo/things/1/files answer with static_dir set, page still served). They failed for the stated reasons (TypeError unexpected keyword routers; /api served the page), then passed. Suite 117 OK (112 + 5). title: Phase 1.10: security floors for the dependencies, tested at the floors and the newest, with a Python audit in CI
description:
The plan's Global Constraints pin the BFF package's dependencies "exactly equal to speech-to-text's": `fastapi==0.115.0`, `python-multipart==0.0.12`, which resolve Starlette 0.38.6. `pip-audit` reports 14 known vulnerabilities in those two packages (found 2026-10-01; see below). A new starter must not begin with them, and an exact-pinned library also forces every module that imports it to the same stack.

Evidence (lead's trial in throwaway virtualenvs, not in this repository): old pins → 14 advisories (python-multipart: multipart parser denial of service through preamble/epilogue/part headers CVE-2026-40347, CVE-2026-42561, excess logging CVE-2024-53981, negative Content-Length reads the body into memory CVE-2026-53540, urlencoded parser CVE-2026-53538/53539; Starlette: unbounded multipart field buffering CVE-2024-47874, event loop blocked on large upload roll-over CVE-2025-54121, unvalidated Host/path in request URL, form limits ignored for urlencoded CVE-2026-54283). Newest versions (fastapi 0.142.2, starlette 1.7.0, uvicorn 0.54.0, httpx 0.28.1, itsdangerous 2.2.0, python-multipart 0.0.32): `pip-audit` clean, and speech-to-text's 117 backend tests pass on them.
FastAPI reads a `File(...)` body before it runs a route's `Depends(...)`, so the multipart cost can be reached before the session check; the floors matter.

## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-kit-plan.md`: Global Constraints (the pin line), Phase 0 Task 0.1 (`pyproject.toml`), Phase 1 exit.
- `docs/design.md` section 6.
- `AGENTS.md`.

## Scope
Branch `feat/bff` (continue it; after bead `kit-module-kit-ojs.17`). Files: `packages/bff/pyproject.toml`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-kit-plan.md` (the Global Constraints pin line and the Task 0.1 `pyproject` block), `docs/design.md` (one line in section 6), `packages/bff/README.md` (one sentence).

The change, and only this:
1. A library declares compatible ranges with security floors, not exact pins: `fastapi>=0.142.2,<1`, `starlette>=1.3.1,<2`, `uvicorn[standard]>=0.54,<1`, `httpx>=0.28,<1`, `itsdangerous>=2.2,<3`, `python-multipart>=0.0.31,<1`. (Exact pins belong to the application: the template pins and locks them, Phase 3.)
2. CI runs the suite twice: at the floors (`uv pip install --resolution lowest-direct`) and at the newest versions; and `pip-audit` on both installed sets must report nothing.
3. Update the plan and design text so they no longer say "exact pins equal to speech-to-text's", and say why (a library; the audit finding).

## Out of scope
- Any source change under `packages/bff/src/` beyond what a newer version forces (report it instead and stop).
- The template, the UI package, speech-to-text's own backend (it has its own bead).

## Steps to Reproduce
`uv venv --python 3.12 v && uv pip install --python v/bin/python 'fastapi==0.115.0' 'python-multipart==0.0.12' && uvx pip-audit --path v/lib/python3.12/site-packages` → 14 known vulnerabilities.

## Steps
1. Reproduce: a venv from the old pins, `uvx pip-audit --path <venv>/lib/python3.12/site-packages` → 14 findings.
2. Change `pyproject.toml`; build two fresh venvs (floors, newest); run the suite in both; run `pip-audit` on both.
3. Add the CI job(s); validate the YAML (`uv run --with pyyaml python -c ...`).
4. Update the docs listed above. Commit: `fix(bff): security floors for the dependencies, tested at the floors and the newest, with a Python audit in CI`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The whole suite passes at the floors and at the newest versions.

title: Phase 1.11: BFF hardening from the adversary review (header allowlist, control characters, set-cookie, inline files, callback input, config)
description:
The adversary review of the BFF (read-only agent, 2026-10-01, scripts reproduced each finding) found no exploitable P0, one P1 and several P2s. Everything below was verified by running it; the lead judged each item. Fixes are the clean, structural ones; items that are not fixed in code are fixed in the documents.

## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-kit-plan.md`: Global Constraints, Phase 1 Tasks 1.2, 1.5, 1.6.
- `docs/design.md`: section 2 (contract), K6, K7.
- `AGENTS.md`.

## Scope
Branch `feat/bff` (continue it; after beads `.17` and `.18`). Files: `packages/bff/src/eneo_module_bff/{auth,proxy,transport,settings}.py`, their tests, `docs/design.md`, `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-kit-plan.md`, `packages/bff/README.md`. One commit per numbered fix, tests first (each fix has a test that fails first, shown), then one `chore: update the Beads board` commit.

### Fix list
1. **P1 — only an allowlist of request headers reaches Eneo.** Today the proxy drops a denylist and forwards the rest, so `Transfer-Encoding`, `TE`, `Upgrade`, `Proxy-Authorization`, `X-Forwarded-*`, `Forwarded`, `X-Real-IP` reach Eneo on a pool shared by all users and carrying the service key (a chunked request arrives with both `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and `Content-Length`; a user can forge `X-Forwarded-For`, which Eneo's audit log may record). Replace the denylist with `FORWARDED_REQUEST_HEADERS = {"accept", "accept-language", "content-type", "idempotency-key", "if-match", "if-none-match"}` (lowercase, exported constant) plus `create_app(..., forward_request_headers: Sequence[str] = ())` for a module that needs more; the credentials are still set by `upstream_auth_headers`. This deliberately departs from "copy the header sets unchanged" in plan Task 1.5: change that sentence and add one line in design K6 ("deny by default, for paths and for headers"). Tests: each header above is dropped; an allowlisted one passes; a module-added one passes; the custom API-key header name and `Cookie`/`Authorization`/`Origin`/`Referer` still never reach Eneo.
2. **P2 — a path with a control character or a backslash is refused (403), never 500.** `flows/a%00b/runs/` and `%0D` raise `httpx.InvalidURL` (not a `RequestError`), and a backslash goes upstream literally. Extend `leaves_route` to refuse any decoded character below U+0020, U+007F and `\`. Test the proxy and `forward_upload`/`stream_signed` ids.
3. **P2 — Eneo's `Set-Cookie` is not passed to the browser** (several were merged into one line, and a cookie named like the module's session would overwrite it). Add `set-cookie` to the response headers that are dropped. Proxy responses also get `Cache-Control: private, no-store` when Eneo sent none.
4. **P2 — a streamed file is shown inline only if it is safe to.** `stream_signed` asks Eneo for `inline` and forwards `Content-Type`, so a user-uploaded `text/html` file is served inline from the module's origin (only the CSP protects it). Force `Content-Disposition: attachment` unless the media type is `audio/*`, `video/*`, `application/pdf` or `image/png|jpeg|gif|webp`; keep `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`. Add `inline_types: Sequence[str]` to `stream_signed` to widen it. Test text/html → attachment, audio/webm with Range → inline and 206.
5. **P2 — callback input is handled, not crashed on.** A non-ASCII `state` with a valid cookie makes `secrets.compare_digest` raise `TypeError` (500): compare `.encode()`d bytes. A second login must end the session the browser already holds (delete the old session id from the store in `callback`): today a second login leaves two sessions alive.
6. **P2 — `next` is bounded and cannot swallow the query.** A 6 000-character `next` makes an 8 KB state cookie that browsers drop (login fails as `invalid_state`): `module_path` falls back to `home_path` above 512 characters. `with_query` must put the query before a `#` fragment (use `urlsplit`/`urlunsplit`); today `/page#top` becomes `/page#top?fel=annan-anvandare` and the UI never sees the signal.
7. **P2 — configuration is normalised.** `module_origin` and the `Origin` it is compared with are compared in canonical form (lowercase scheme and host, default port dropped): `https://Mod.Example.SE` or `:443` makes every write 403 today. A token's `session_expires_at` without a time zone is read as UTC (today as local time: a 2 h shift under `Europe/Stockholm`). `_required_url` refuses a bare `?` or `#` (`"?" in value or "#" in value`).
8. **P2 — an unexpected exception while refreshing does not turn into 500 on every request.** In `_refresh`, catch `Exception` (after the specific handling), log it, and treat it like "Eneo cannot answer": keep the token and retry later.

### Document fixes (no code)
- Design §2: "reject a missing, reused or mismatched state" → say what the code does: the state is bound to the browser by a signed, short-lived cookie that the callback deletes; one-time use is enforced by Eneo's ticket (do **not** build a seen-state store).
- Design §2: "On 401/403 end the session" → "on any refusal other than 408, 429 or 5xx".
- Plan Phase 3 "Backend test (Review Focus 5)": the route walker must cover WebSocket routes too (`APIWebSocketRoute` has no `.methods`): every WebSocket route needs both `require_session` and `require_same_origin`. Write that test against a router with one WebSocket route in this bead (`test_deps.py`) so Phase 3 can reuse it.

## Out of scope
- Request body size limits and unauthenticated body parsing (a separate bead from the performance review).
- A seen-state store, rate limiting, sticky or shared sessions.
- Anything in `web.py`, `app.py` beyond the `forward_request_headers` parameter.

## Steps to Reproduce
The adversary's scripts are under /tmp/adv/ (a8_te.py: chunked request reaches Eneo with Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length; a3_proxy.py, a7_transport.py: %00 gives 500 and a backslash goes upstream). Each fix's first test reproduces its finding.

## Steps
For each numbered fix: write the failing test(s), run them (show the failure), implement, run the whole suite, commit with message `fix(bff): <what>`. Then the documents. Then the Phase 1 exit again (suite at floors and newest after `.18`, the two greps, wheel build and install, suite against the wheel), re-close `.10`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every fix has a test that failed before and passes after; the whole suite passes.
- The adversary's reproduction scripts no longer reproduce items 1–8 (re-run `/tmp/adv/a*.py` if they still exist, otherwise the new tests are the proof).
- The two exit greps still print nothing.

## Verify
```bash
.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s packages/bff/tests -t packages/bff
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead. Do not weaken a fix to keep a carried-over test passing; report the test.
close_reason: Eight fixes, one commit each on feat/bff, each with tests written first and shown failing, then the whole suite green (117 -> 155 tests). 1 P1 header allowlist 366a363: +5 tests; failed first on x-forwarded-for reaching Eneo and no ValueError for credential/framing names; FORWARDED_REQUEST_HEADERS + create_app(forward_request_headers=); a module cannot add Cookie/Authorization/Origin/Referer/X-API-Key/Host/Content-Length/Transfer-Encoding (ValueError), the configured API-key header stays the module's; plan Task 1.5 sentence and design K6 changed. 2 control chars/backslash c1187d9: +6; failed 200!=403 and 502!=403; leaves_route refuses <U+0020, U+007F and backslash in the decoded path and after a second decode; ordinary ids (space, non-ASCII, ~) still pass; NOTE a decoded newline is a 404 from the router's own {path:path} pattern (it does not match \n) before the proxy, not 403: never reaches Eneo, never 500, pinned by a test. 3 Set-Cookie + cache 0613b39: +2; failed with both cookies merged into one set-cookie line; set-cookie dropped, Cache-Control private,no-store when Eneo sent none (Eneo's value kept otherwise). 4 inline only if safe d4b565f: +6; failed with text/html forwarded inline; attachment (keeping Eneo's filename) unless audio/*, video/*, application/pdf, image/png|jpeg|gif|webp; stream_signed(inline_types=); nosniff set on the stream. 5 callback ea1eb5e: +4; failed TypeError on non-ASCII state and old session alive; bytes compare; callback deletes the held session after the new one exists (not on a failed login or renewal by another user). 6 next/with_query afb5954: +4; failed with a 6322-byte state cookie and /inloggad#top?fel=...; next above 512 characters falls back to home_path; with_query puts the query before the fragment. (The size test uses random characters: itsdangerous compresses a repeated one.) 7 configuration 689840c: +5; canonical_origin (lower-case scheme/host, default port dropped, strict for an Origin header: no path/query/userinfo); naive session_expires_at is UTC (tested under TZ=Europe/Stockholm); _required_url refuses bare ? and #. 8 refresh cede23d: +2; failed RuntimeError reaching every request; _refresh catches Exception (not BaseException), logs, keeps the token, retries in 10 s, one attempt shared by 8 concurrent requests. Walker de3d152: +4 in test_deps.py: unguarded_routes(*routers) checks require_session (however deep), require_same_origin for writes and every WebSocket route, and reports a route it cannot check. DISCOVERY: FastAPI 0.142 keeps an included router as one _IncludedRouter in app.routes, so a walker over app.routes cannot see module routes through public API; the walker therefore takes the module's routers (router.routes) and the plan's Phase 3 row now says so. Docs 9832aa8: design section 2 (state binding and one-time use by Eneo's ticket, refresh refusals other than 408/429/5xx, header allowlist, a new login ends the held session). Adversary scripts /tmp/adv re-run on the fixed code: a8 (real socket) Eneo gets Content-Length 5 and no Transfer-Encoding, browser gets no Set-Cookie; a7 %00/%5C -> 403 no upstream, text/html -> attachment; a1/a2/a9 non-ASCII state -> invalid_state, oversized next cookie 262-265 bytes, fel kept before #top, canonical origin, bare ?/# refused, naive time zone same under UTC and Stockholm, one session after two logins; a4 case 8: [200,200,200], one refresh attempt, session kept; a5 WebSocket and origin checks as before. a3's header section errors on a script bug (explicit Cookie header replaces the session cookie under Starlette 1.x). title: Phase 1.12: HTTP client — httpx2 or httpx, decided with evidence (Starlette deprecates the httpx test client)
description:
Newest Starlette warns on every test client: "Using `httpx` with `starlette.testclient` is deprecated; install `httpx2` instead." (observed 2026-10-01, Starlette 1.7.0). PyPI: `httpx2` 2.13.1, "The next generation HTTP client", repository `pydantic/httpx2`; `httpx` itself has no stable release after 0.28.1 (only 1.0.dev pre-releases). The BFF's runtime HTTP client is `httpx.AsyncClient` (callback, refresh, proxy, uploads, streaming), so this is a decision about the runtime dependency as well as the tests. The owner wants everything on the latest, maintained versions.

## Read first
- `packages/bff/src/eneo_module_bff/{app,auth,proxy,transport}.py` (every `httpx` use), `packages/bff/pyproject.toml`, `packages/bff/tests/`.
- `docs/design.md` section 6.
- `AGENTS.md`.

## Scope
Branch `feat/bff` (continue it; after beads `.19` and the performance bead if one is created). Files: `packages/bff/pyproject.toml`, `packages/bff/src/eneo_module_bff/*.py` (imports and the client class only), `packages/bff/tests/*`, `docs/design.md` (one paragraph recording the decision), the plan's Tech stack and pin lines.

## Out of scope
- Any behaviour change. Any new feature of the new client (HTTP/2, brotli, zstd) unless it is needed for parity.
- speech-to-text's backend (it keeps `httpx` until it adopts the kit or gets its own bead).

## Steps
1. Read the `httpx2` changelog and release history: how often it releases, who maintains it, open security advisories (`pip-audit`, GitHub security tab via `gh api repos/pydantic/httpx2`), and whether `httpcore2` is pinned to it exactly (`httpcore2==2.13.1`). Write the findings (five lines) as a comment on this bead.
2. Trial in a throwaway venv: replace `httpx` with `httpx2` in the package and tests (`import httpx2 as httpx` is NOT acceptable in the result: change the names properly), run the whole suite, then the adversary scripts that exist under `/tmp/adv/` for the proxy, uploads and streaming, and measure: upload of 300 MB and 1 GB to a slow fake Eneo, 20 concurrent Range streams, peak RSS and event-loop latency, the same numbers on `httpx` 0.28.1 (a script under `/tmp`, not committed).
3. Decide, with the numbers: use `httpx2` if the suite passes, memory and latency are no worse, and it is actively maintained with no open advisory; otherwise keep `httpx` for the runtime, switch only the tests' client if Starlette allows it, and record why. If the answer is not clear, stop and put the numbers and your recommendation on this bead for the lead.
4. If switching: update `pyproject.toml` floors (`httpx2>=<tested minimum>,<3`), CI matrix (floors and newest), `pip-audit`, docs. One commit: `refactor(bff): use httpx2, the maintained HTTP client`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The decision and its evidence are on the bead and in `docs/design.md`.
- If switched: no `import httpx` remains in the package or tests, the suite passes at the floors and the newest, `pip-audit` is clean, the Starlette deprecation warning is gone, and the measured memory and latency are no worse than with `httpx`.
